# Lasting power of attorney: continuation of appointment details

Donor: ⟦PERSON|Maelin Veskett⟧

**Attorneys acting together:** ⟦PERSON|Nerisa Fallow⟧ & ⟦PERSON|Tovin Quenell⟧

**Replacement attorneys:** ⟦PERSON|Avella Wrenick⟧ & ⟦PERSON|Corven Mesk⟧

This continuation sheet records the individuals named in the appointment.

The attorneys must retain a record of substantial expenditure and keep the donor's property separate from their own. A decision to employ professional assistance must record the work requested and the reason that assistance was appropriate. The appointment does not authorise an attorney to treat an expense of their own household as the donor's expense.

The replacements are to act only in the circumstances specified in the signed appointment. Their inclusion on this sheet does not permit them to intervene while both original attorneys remain able and authorised to act. Any uncertainty about the replacement mechanism must be resolved before relying on the appointment for a transaction.

The donor requests that an annual summary be supplied to the nominated contact. That request does not transfer decision-making authority to the contact or permit disclosure of unrelated records.

Signed by the donor: ⟦PERSON|Maelin Veskett⟧

Continuation sheet dated 12 December 2026. Paragraph 4.2 concerns the expense record.
